module: Rally note style 'English casual': a simplified English co-driver that calls corners as 'easy / medium / hard' (easy_medium_hard numbering) plus the flat, square and hairpin descriptors. It speaks no distance calls (distance.callsEnabled = false), no lengths and no corner shapes. It uses only a subset of modifiers (jumps, crests, splashes, surface changes, stop/finish, chicanes) and aliases that map the other variants to those modifiers. Reuses the distance, visual, caution, systemPacenotes and modifiers modules from the english folder.
notes: File WARNING: any change to a string used for a note requires regenerating the audio files.
The style composes the same way as the others: M.composite = compositorUtil.compositeFromPhrases, M.enumerate = compositorUtil.enumerateConcise.
The aliases (casualModifierAliases): jump/badDipJump/badJump/bigJump -> overJump; crest variants -> crest; water/intoWater -> watersplash; overFinish -> finish; openHairpin/tightHairpin -> hairpin.
The descriptorAliases field exists only in this style among the three styles of this series.
Validated by styleValidator when loaded by textCompositor.

composite.desc: compositorUtil.compositeFromPhrases: (config, structured, distBefore, distAfter, escapeVars) -> list of texts.

enumerate.desc: compositorUtil.enumerateConcise: (textCompositor, config) -> list of unique phrases.

distance.desc: Distance config copied from the english/distance style but with callsEnabled = false (no spoken distance calls).

visualGeneral.desc: General colors of the visual notes (intoColor, distanceColor), from english/visual.

componentTypes.desc: Component registry: corner (easy_medium_hard numbering, left/right direction, flat/square/hairpin descriptors), caution (english/caution), modifiers (subset) and modifierAliases.
